uic.Modal.ok.description: Default label of the modal's primary action button

uic.Modal.cancel.description: Default label of the modal's cancel button, which closes it

uic.PageHeader.retry.description: Button in the page header's error banner that retries the failed load

uic.PageHeader.dismissError.description: Accessible name of the icon button that closes the error banner

uic.SkeletonCard.loading.description: Accessible name of a card-shaped loading placeholder

uic.SkeletonChart.loading.description: Accessible name of a chart-shaped loading placeholder

uic.SkeletonRow.loading.description: Accessible name of one list-row loading placeholder

uic.SkeletonText.loading.description: Accessible name of a text-block loading placeholder

uic.BooleanToken.true.description: Default label of a token showing a boolean value that is true

uic.BooleanToken.false.description: Default label of a token showing a boolean value that is false

uic.NotificationStack.cancel.description: Default label of the button that cancels a notice's background task

uic.NotificationStack.retry.description: Default label of the button that retries a notice's failed task

uic.NotificationStack.progress.description: Accessible name of a notice's progress bar when the notice title is not plain text
